svg.title: Reliability collapses with step count
svg.desc: A hand-drawn chart of end-to-end agent success against the number of autonomous steps from one to twenty. Three declining curves show 90, 95 and 99 percent per-step reliability, reaching 34.9, 59.9 and 90.4 percent at ten steps, while a much flatter green curve for 95 percent with one verified retry - an effective 0.9975 - stays at 97.5 percent. A faint half-erased earlier attempt at the 95 percent curve is left visible underneath, an amber band covers steps one to four as where constrained workflows live, and an arrow labelled 'just add more steps' is struck through in red.
svg.text: the green curve is Week 31. That
is why evals are not optional -
